ex.en: His home is furnished in a very cozy way.
ex.zh: 他家布置得非常溫馨。

ex.en: The couple spent a lot of money on furnishing their house.
ex.zh: 那對夫婦花了很多錢添購家具布置房子。

ex.en: The apartment comes fully furnished.
ex.zh: 這間公寓附全套家具。

furnish.en: to put tables, beds and other things in a room

ex.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.
ex.zh: 那個組織為難民提供了食物。

ex.en: They furnished the library with many books.
ex.zh: 他們為圖書館提供了很多書。

furnish.en: to give someone something they need

ex.en: We are fundraising for a new library.
ex.zh: 我們正在為新圖書館募款。

ex.en: The students fundraised to pay for the trip.
ex.zh: 學生們募款來支付旅費。

fundraise.en: to collect money for a cause

ex.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
ex.zh: 這些問題在不久的將來都會解決。

ex.en: I want to be a pilot in the future.
ex.zh: 將來我想當飛行員。

ex.en: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
ex.zh: 誰知道未來會發生什麼事？

future.en: the time that has not yet come

ex.en: Mrs. Harris is very doubtful about her son's future.
ex.zh: 哈里斯太太對兒子的前途很沒信心。

ex.en: This job has a bright future.
ex.zh: 這份工作很有前途。

future.en: what will happen to someone or something later

ex.en: Let's keep this for future use.
ex.zh: 我們把這個留著以後用吧。

ex.en: We look forward to future orders from you.
ex.zh: 期待您日後繼續訂購。

ex.en: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
ex.zh: 馬停了下來，不肯再往前走。

ex.en: He was too tired to go any further.
ex.zh: 他太累了，走不動了。

ex.en: Wait, don't go any further. Something feels off here.
ex.zh: 等一下，別再往前走了，這裡感覺不太對勁。

ex.en: Lady Catherine, I have nothing further to say.
ex.zh: 凱瑟琳夫人，我沒有別的話要說了。

ex.en: For further information, please contact us.
ex.zh: 如需進一步資訊，請與我們聯絡。

ex.en: Its modernisation went much further than I had expected.
ex.zh: 它現代化的程度遠遠超乎我的預期。

ex.en: We need to discuss this further.
ex.zh: 我們需要進一步討論這件事。

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封交給瑪麗。

ex.en: The lakes and rivers, too, are full of fish.
ex.zh: 湖泊和河流裡也都是魚。

ex.en: The restaurant was full, so we went home.
ex.zh: 餐廳客滿了，所以我們就回家了。

full.en: holding as much as possible, with no space left

ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔上可以看到整個城市的全景。

ex.en: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有學生在中國古典文學拿到滿分。

ex.en: Please write your full name here.
ex.zh: 請在這裡寫上你的全名。

ex.en: No more, thanks. I'm full.
ex.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我吃飽了。

ex.en: I'm too full to eat dessert.
ex.zh: 我太飽了，吃不下甜點。

full.en: having eaten enough so that you want no more

ex.en: He was arrested for abusing public funds.
ex.zh: 他因濫用公款而被捕。

ex.en: He took US$1 million retirement funds.
ex.zh: 他領走了一百萬美元的退休基金。

ex.en: We don't have enough funds for the project.
ex.zh: 我們沒有足夠的資金做這個專案。

fund.en: an amount of money kept for a particular purpose

ex.en: The project is funded by the government.
ex.zh: 這個專案由政府資助。

ex.en: Who will fund the new research center?
ex.zh: 誰會出資興建新的研究中心？

fund.en: to provide the money for something

ex.en: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
ex.zh: 煞車的功能是讓車子停下來。

ex.en: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
ex.zh: 記憶是大腦的重要功能。

function.en: the purpose or job of a thing or person

ex.en: The new system is functioning well.
ex.zh: 新系統運作良好。

ex.en: The elevator isn't functioning properly.
ex.zh: 電梯運作不正常。

function.en: to work in the correct way

ex.en: A quadratic function cannot be used here.
ex.zh: 這裡不能用二次函數。

ex.en: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
ex.zh: 由於一些寫得很糟的函式，系統大部分時間都不穩定。

function.en: a rule or piece of code that gives a result from a number or input

ex.en: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
ex.zh: 學習外語裡的俚語很有趣。

ex.en: It'll be more fun if we do it together.
ex.zh: 我們一起做的話會更好玩。

ex.en: Have fun at the party!
ex.zh: 派對玩得開心！

ex.en: We had a fun day at the beach.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊度過了好玩的一天。

ex.en: She is a fun person to work with.
ex.zh: 跟她一起工作很有趣。

ex.en: Don't make fun of his accent.
ex.zh: 不要取笑他的口音。

ex.en: The kids made fun of my new haircut.
ex.zh: 孩子們取笑我的新髮型。

fun.en: to laugh at someone in an unkind way

ex.en: I fully agree with your point of view.
ex.zh: 我完全同意你的觀點。

ex.en: I am fully convinced of your innocence.
ex.zh: 我完全相信你是清白的。

ex.en: All the flights on March 30th were fully booked.
ex.zh: 3 月 30 日的班機全部客滿。

ex.en: That is the funniest joke that I have ever heard.
ex.zh: 這是我聽過最好笑的笑話。

ex.en: The teacher told us a funny story.
ex.zh: 老師跟我們講了一個有趣的故事。

ex.en: Who's the funniest person in your class?
ex.zh: 你們班上最搞笑的人是誰？

ex.en: The milk smells funny.
ex.zh: 牛奶聞起來怪怪的。

ex.en: My computer is making a funny noise.
ex.zh: 我的電腦發出奇怪的聲音。

funny.en: strange and not as it should be

ex.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
ex.zh: 煤和天然氣是天然燃料。

ex.en: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.
ex.zh: 這台暖氣設備用柴油當燃料。

ex.en: The fuel tank in the car is full.
ex.zh: 車子的油箱是滿的。

fuel.en: something burned to produce heat or power

ex.en: Recognition fuels progress.
ex.zh: 認可能推動進步。

ex.en: Low interest rates fueled the housing boom.
ex.zh: 低利率助長了房市熱潮。

fuel.en: to make something stronger or make it continue

ex.en: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.
ex.zh: 而且，我還是不認為這是很大的文化差異。

ex.en: The plan is too expensive. Furthermore, it will take too long.
ex.zh: 這個計畫太貴了，而且也太花時間。

furthermore.en: used to add another point to what you have said

ex.en: The family is the fundamental unit of society.
ex.zh: 家庭是社會的基本單位。

ex.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
ex.zh: 尊重法律是我們社會的根基。

ex.en: Math is fundamental to any science.
ex.zh: 數學是一切科學的基礎。

fundamental.en: most important and forming the base of something

ex.en: You need to learn the fundamentals first.
ex.zh: 你得先學會基本功。

ex.en: The fundamentals of the economy remain strong.
ex.zh: 經濟的基本面依然強勁。

fundamental.en: the basic rules or parts of a subject

ex.en: I hope I can get my wish fulfilled.
ex.zh: 希望我的願望能實現。

ex.en: She finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 她終於實現了當醫生的夢想。

fulfill.en: to make a hope or wish come true

fulfill.zh: 履行、滿足（承諾、要求、訂單）

ex.en: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
ex.zh: 測試結果顯示，系統已經符合所有設計要求。

ex.en: We can fulfill your order within three days.
ex.zh: 我們可以在三天內完成您的訂單。

fulfill.en: to do what is promised or needed

ex.en: The office is simple but functional.
ex.zh: 辦公室很簡單但很實用。

ex.en: The design is both beautiful and functional.
ex.zh: 這個設計既美觀又實用。

functional.en: designed to be useful rather than beautiful

ex.en: The elevator is fully functional again.
ex.zh: 電梯又能正常運作了。

ex.en: Is the old printer still functional?
ex.zh: 那台舊印表機還能用嗎？

ex.en: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
ex.zh: 從根本上說，十二生肖的形成與動物崇拜有關。

ex.en: The two plans are fundamentally different.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫根本上就不同。

ex.en: We need to fundamentally change the way we work.
ex.zh: 我們必須從根本上改變工作方式。

fundamentally.en: in the most important and basic ways

ex.en: Mushrooms are a type of fungus.
ex.zh: 菇類是一種真菌。

ex.en: The tree was killed by a fungus.
ex.zh: 這棵樹被一種真菌害死了。

fungus.en: a living thing like a mushroom or mold that has no leaves or flowers

ex.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
ex.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的結合。

ex.en: The restaurant serves Asian fusion cuisine.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應亞洲融合料理。

fusion.en: the mixing of different things into one

ex.en: Nuclear fusion powers the sun.
ex.zh: 核融合為太陽提供能量。

ex.en: Scientists hope fusion will provide clean energy.
ex.zh: 科學家希望核融合能提供乾淨能源。

fusion.en: the joining of small parts of atoms to make energy

ex.en: There is too much furniture in the house.
ex.zh: 房子裡家具太多了。

ex.en: All the furniture in the room was all worn out.
ex.zh: 房間裡的家具都很舊了。

ex.en: We rented a truck to move our furniture.
ex.zh: 我們租了一輛卡車來搬家具。

furniture.en: things such as tables, chairs and beds in a room

ex.en: I feel bad about not having gone to his funeral.
ex.zh: 我因為沒有參加他的葬禮而感到很糟糕。

ex.en: A great many people attended his funeral.
ex.zh: 很多人都參加了他的葬禮。

ex.en: Tom's funeral will be this weekend.
ex.zh: 湯姆的葬禮訂在這週末。

funeral.en: a ceremony held after a person has died

ex.en: She shook with fury when she read the letter.
ex.zh: 她讀完那封信後氣得渾身發抖。

ex.en: His fury was obvious to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他的暴怒讓房間裡的每個人都看得出來。

ex.en: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
ex.zh: 當湯姆發現這件事時，他很生氣。

ex.en: Adam was furious with me when I broke his watch.
ex.zh: 我把亞當的手錶弄壞了，氣得他七竅生煙。

ex.en: Mother will be furious for sure!
ex.zh: 媽媽一定會氣炸的！

ex.en: Amazon has fulfillment centers all over the world.
ex.zh: 亞馬遜在世界各地都有物流中心。

ex.en: Order fulfillment usually takes one to two days.
ex.zh: 訂單出貨通常需要一到兩天。

fulfillment.en: the process of getting and sending customers' orders

ex.en: Teaching gives her a sense of fulfillment.
ex.zh: 教書讓她很有成就感。

ex.en: The trip was the fulfillment of a lifelong dream.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行實現了他畢生的夢想。

fulfillment.en: the happy feeling of getting what you wanted from life

ex.en: The new version adds more functionality.
ex.zh: 新版本增加了更多功能。

ex.en: The app is simple but has all the functionality you need.
ex.zh: 這個 App 很簡單，但你需要的功能都有。

functionality.en: the things that a program or machine can do

ex.en: The furnished apartment includes a bed, desk, and sofa.
ex.zh: 這間附家具的公寓備有床、書桌和沙發。

ex.en: They chose a furnished unit because their stay was temporary.
ex.zh: 他們選擇家具齊全的房子，因為只會短期居住。

furnished.en: having tables, beds and other things already in it

ex.en: The school received new funding for its science lab.
ex.zh: 這所學校獲得了新的經費來建科學實驗室。

ex.en: The project failed because of a lack of funding.
ex.zh: 這個計畫因為缺乏資金而失敗。

ex.en: He worked hard to fulfil his dream of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 他努力工作，想實現成為醫生的夢想。

ex.en: The company must fulfil its promises to customers.
ex.zh: 公司必須履行對客戶的承諾。

ex.en: You need to fulfil all the requirements to apply.
ex.zh: 你必須符合所有條件才能申請。

ex.en: This job does not fulfil my needs anymore.
ex.zh: 這份工作已經無法滿足我的需求了。

ex.en: The cat has soft grey fur.
ex.zh: 這隻貓有柔軟的灰色毛。

ex.en: She wore a coat with a fur collar.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件有毛皮領子的外套。

ex.en: Fur built up inside the kettle.
ex.zh: 水壺裡積了一層水垢。

ex.en: Clean the fur from the pipe with vinegar.
ex.zh: 用醋清除水管裡的水垢。

ex.en: There was a big fuss when the flight was cancelled.
ex.zh: 班機被取消時引起一陣騷動。

ex.en: Don't make a fuss; it's only a small scratch.
ex.zh: 別大驚小怪，只是一點小擦傷而已。

ex.en: Stop fussing over the details and relax.
ex.zh: 別再為細節瞎操心，放輕鬆吧。

ex.en: The baby fussed all night because of his sore tooth.
ex.zh: 小寶寶因為牙痛，整晚都在鬧。

ex.en: The photo is too fuzzy to see anyone's face.
ex.zh: 這張照片太模糊了，看不清任何人的臉。

ex.en: I have only a fuzzy memory of that day.
ex.zh: 我對那一天只有模糊的記憶。

ex.en: The kitten has soft fuzzy fur.
ex.zh: 這隻小貓有柔軟毛茸茸的毛。

ex.en: She wore a warm fuzzy sweater in winter.
ex.zh: 她冬天穿一件暖和毛茸茸的毛衣。

ex.en: He fumed in traffic for an hour.
ex.zh: 他在塞車時氣了一個小時。

ex.en: She fumed when she saw the bill.
ex.zh: 她看到帳單時氣得冒火。

ex.en: The fumes from the paint made me dizzy.
ex.zh: 油漆的氣味讓我頭暈。

ex.en: Car fumes make the air in the city dirty.
ex.zh: 汽車廢氣讓城市的空氣很髒。

ex.en: Teaching gives her a deep sense of fulfilment.
ex.zh: 教書給她帶來深深的成就感。

ex.en: He found fulfilment in helping others.
ex.zh: 他從幫助別人當中得到滿足。

ex.en: The fulfilment of this dream took ten years.
ex.zh: 實現這個夢想花了十年。

ex.en: The contract requires the fulfilment of all conditions.
ex.zh: 合約要求履行所有條件。

ex.en: The hotel's furnishings are simple but comfortable.
ex.zh: 這間旅館的家具陳設簡單但舒適。

ex.en: They spent a lot of money on furnishings for the new house.
ex.zh: 他們花了很多錢添購新家的家具擺設。

ex.en: He fumbled in his pocket for the keys.
ex.zh: 他在口袋裡摸索著找鑰匙。

ex.en: The receiver fumbled the ball near the goal line.
ex.zh: 接球員在球門線附近漏接了球。

ex.en: A costly fumble in the last minute lost them the game.
ex.zh: 最後一分鐘的一次致命漏球讓他們輸掉了比賽。

ex.en: After a nervous fumble, she finally unlocked the door.
ex.zh: 她緊張地手忙腳亂了一陣後，終於把門打開。

ex.en: The old radio is still functioning well.
ex.zh: 那台舊收音機仍然運作良好。

ex.en: A fully functioning kitchen is essential for a restaurant.
ex.zh: 餐廳必須要有功能完整的廚房。

ex.en: The functioning of the heart depends on a steady blood supply.
ex.zh: 心臟的運作仰賴穩定的血液供應。

ex.en: The report looks at the daily functioning of the school.
ex.zh: 這份報告探討學校的日常運作。

ex.en: He slammed the door and shouted furiously at his brother.
ex.zh: 他用力甩上門，憤怒地對著弟弟大吼。

ex.en: She typed furiously to finish the report before midnight.
ex.zh: 她拚命打字，想在午夜前完成報告。

ex.en: The hotel's furnishings are simple but comfortable.
ex.zh: 飯店的傢俱簡單但舒適。

ex.en: We spent the weekend choosing furnishings for the new house.
ex.zh: 我們花了一個週末為新家挑選傢俱和陳設。

ex.en: The old furnishings gave the room a warm feeling.
ex.zh: 舊傢俱讓房間有種溫暖的感覺。

ex.en: The fugitive was caught near the border after three days.
ex.zh: 那名逃犯在三天後於邊境附近被抓獲。

ex.en: Police asked the public to report any sign of the fugitive.
ex.zh: 警方請民眾提供任何有關逃犯的線索。

ex.en: A fugitive prisoner was hiding in the forest.
ex.zh: 一名逃亡的囚犯躲在森林裡。

ex.en: She caught only a fugitive glimpse of the famous actor.
ex.zh: 她只匆匆瞥見那位名演員一眼。

ex.en: The factory's furnace burns day and night to melt the steel.
ex.zh: 工廠的熔爐日夜燃燒，用來熔化鋼鐵。

ex.en: Our furnace broke down in the middle of winter.
ex.zh: 我們家的暖氣爐在隆冬時壞掉了。

ex.en: The car was a furnace after sitting in the sun all afternoon.
ex.zh: 那輛車在太陽下曬了一下午，裡面熱得像火爐。

ex.en: The war was a furnace that tested the young nation.
ex.zh: 那場戰爭是對這個年輕國家的嚴酷考驗。

fundamentalist.zh: 基要主義者、教條主義者

ex.en: The book describes a fundamentalist who rejects all modern ideas.
ex.zh: 這本書描寫一位拒絕所有現代觀念的基要主義者。

ex.en: Some fundamentalists believe every word of their text must be taken literally.
ex.zh: 有些基要主義者相信經文的每個字都必須照字面理解。

ex.en: It was futile to argue with him, so I stopped.
ex.zh: 跟他爭論是白費力氣，所以我就不說了。

ex.en: Their futile attempts to start the old car made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他們發動那輛舊車的徒勞嘗試讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: The lights went out because a fuse blew.
ex.zh: 燈熄了，因為保險絲燒斷了。

ex.en: He lit the fuse and ran away from the firework.
ex.zh: 他點燃了導火線，然後從煙火旁跑開。

ex.en: Heat can fuse two pieces of metal together.
ex.zh: 高溫能把兩塊金屬熔接在一起。

ex.en: The band fuses jazz and rock in its music.
ex.zh: 這個樂團把爵士與搖滾融合在音樂裡。

ex.en: She wore a funky hat with bright colors.
ex.zh: 她戴了一頂顏色鮮豔、很有個性的帽子。

ex.en: The cafe has a funky design with old posters on the walls.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館的設計很特別，牆上貼著老海報。

ex.en: The band played a funky tune that got everyone dancing.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了一首讓大家起舞的放克曲子。

ex.en: I love the funky bass line in this song.
ex.zh: 我喜歡這首歌裡放克風格的貝斯旋律。

ex.en: Something in the fridge smells funky.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡有東西聞起來怪怪的。

ex.en: His old gym socks had a funky smell.
ex.zh: 他那雙舊運動襪有股怪味。

ex.en: Use a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle.
ex.zh: 用漏斗把油倒進瓶子裡。

ex.en: She put a paper funnel in the narrow jar.
ex.zh: 她把一個紙漏斗放進窄口瓶。

ex.en: Smoke rose from the ship's funnel.
ex.zh: 煙從船的煙囪冒出來。

ex.en: The old steam train had a tall black funnel.
ex.zh: 那輛老蒸汽火車有一根高高的黑色煙囪。

funded.zh: 資助；出資（fund 的過去式）

ex.en: The city funded a new library last year.
ex.zh: 市政府去年出資興建了一座新圖書館。

ex.en: Their parents funded the trip.
ex.zh: 他們的父母資助了這趟旅行。

ex.en: It is a publicly funded school.
ex.zh: 這是一所公費經營的學校。

ex.en: The project is privately funded.
ex.zh: 這個計畫是由民間出資的。

fundamentalism.zh: 基本教義派；原教旨主義

ex.en: Fundamentalism exists in many religions around the world.
ex.zh: 基本教義派存在於世界上許多宗教中。

ex.en: The book explains the rise of religious fundamentalism.
ex.zh: 這本書解釋了宗教基本教義主義的興起。

ex.en: He used a cream to treat a fungal infection on his foot.
ex.zh: 他用藥膏治療腳上的黴菌感染。

ex.en: Damp walls can encourage fungal growth.
ex.zh: 潮濕的牆面容易滋生黴菌。

ex.en: The kitten is small, soft, and furry.
ex.zh: 這隻小貓又小又軟，毛茸茸的。

ex.en: He wore a furry hat in the cold weather.
ex.zh: 天氣冷時他戴著一頂毛茸茸的帽子。

ex.en: The fuselage of the plane was painted white.
ex.zh: 飛機的機身漆成白色。

ex.en: Workers checked the fuselage for cracks.
ex.zh: 工人檢查機身有沒有裂縫。

ex.en: He loves old funk records with strong bass lines.
ex.zh: 他喜歡低音線很強的老放克唱片。

ex.en: The band plays a mix of funk and jazz.
ex.zh: 這個樂團演奏放克與爵士的混合風格。

ex.en: He has been in a funk since he lost his job.
ex.zh: 他自從失業後一直很消沉。

ex.en: A good walk can pull you out of a funk.
ex.zh: 散個好步可以讓你走出低潮。

ex.en: The functionalist believes that every part of society has a purpose.
ex.zh: 功能主義者認為社會的每個部分都有其作用。

ex.en: As a functionalist, he judged a building by how well it worked.
ex.zh: 身為功能主義者，他以建築好不好用來評斷它。

ex.en: She felt the futility of arguing with him.
ex.zh: 她覺得跟他爭論根本是白費力氣。

ex.en: The workers saw the futility of repairing the old machine again.
ex.zh: 工人們明白再修那台舊機器也是徒勞。

ex.en: The soup gave me a pleasant feeling of fullness.
ex.zh: 這碗湯讓我有一種舒服的飽足感。

ex.en: Fiber helps you enjoy a longer sense of fullness after meals.
ex.zh: 纖維能讓你在飯後更久維持飽足感。

ex.en: She spoke about the fullness of her life with gratitude.
ex.zh: 她懷著感激談起自己生活的豐富充實。

ex.en: The fullness of the wine surprised everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 這款酒的醇厚度讓餐桌上的每個人都驚訝。

ex.en: The airport has a futuristic design with glass walls.
ex.zh: 這座機場有著玻璃牆面的未來感設計。

ex.en: He wore futuristic glasses to the party.
ex.zh: 他戴著很有未來感的眼鏡去參加派對。

ex.en: My little brother is a fussy eater.
ex.zh: 我弟弟挑食挑得很。

ex.en: She is fussy about how the table is set.
ex.zh: 她對餐桌怎麼擺很挑剔。

ex.en: The baby gets fussy when she is tired.
ex.zh: 寶寶累的時候就會鬧脾氣。

ex.en: A fussy toddler kept crying on the plane.
ex.zh: 一個愛鬧的幼童在飛機上一直哭。

ex.en: We bought a box of chocolate fudge at the seaside shop.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊的商店買了一盒巧克力軟糖。

ex.en: She topped the ice cream with warm fudge sauce.
ex.zh: 她在冰淇淋上淋了溫熱的軟糖醬。

ex.en: The minister tried to fudge the question about taxes.
ex.zh: 部長試圖對稅務的問題含糊帶過。

ex.en: He was caught fudging the numbers in his report.
ex.zh: 他被發現在報告中動手腳，竄改數字。

ex.en: The farmer planted seeds in each furrow of the field.
ex.zh: 農夫在田裡每一道犁溝中播下種子。

ex.en: A deep furrow appeared between his eyebrows as he read the letter.
ex.zh: 他讀信時，眉間出現了深深的皺紋。

ex.en: She furrowed her brow while trying to solve the puzzle.
ex.zh: 她一邊解謎一邊皺起眉頭。

ex.en: He furrowed his forehead and asked me to repeat the question.
ex.zh: 他皺起額頭，要我再說一次問題。

ex.en: The new law caused a furore among local residents.
ex.zh: 這項新法規在當地居民之間引起軒然大波。

ex.en: The singer's comment sparked a furore online.
ex.zh: 那位歌手的發言在網路上掀起了一陣喧然大波。

ex.en: The new law caused a furor among the voters.
ex.zh: 這項新法令在選民之間引起一陣騷動。

ex.en: There was a public furor over the rise in ticket prices.
ex.zh: 票價上漲引起大眾一片譁然。

ex.en: Our school is busy with fundraising for a new library.
ex.zh: 我們學校正忙著為新圖書館募款。

ex.en: Fundraising events like bake sales help the club pay for trips.
ex.zh: 像園遊會義賣這類募款活動，幫社團支付旅費。

ex.en: They held a fundraising dinner for the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 他們為動物收容所舉辦了一場募款晚宴。

ex.en: The fundraising campaign reached its goal in a week.
ex.zh: 這項募款活動在一週內達成了目標。

ex.en: The two tools are functionally the same.
ex.zh: 這兩種工具在功能上是一樣的。

ex.en: The room is small but functionally designed.
ex.zh: 這個房間雖小，但設計得很實用。

ex.en: I want a fuller cup of coffee, please.
ex.zh: 我想要一杯倒得更滿的咖啡。

ex.en: This shampoo makes your hair look fuller.
ex.zh: 這款洗髮精讓你的頭髮看起來更豐盈。

ex.en: After lunch I felt fuller than I expected.
ex.zh: 午餐後我比預期的更飽。

ex.en: The fullback blocked the shot just before the goal line.
ex.zh: 後衛在球門線前擋下了那一記射門。

ex.en: Our team's fullback is fast and very strong.
ex.zh: 我們隊上的後衛速度快、力量也大。

furtive.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷摸摸的

ex.en: He cast a furtive glance at the door before opening the box.
ex.zh: 他打開盒子前，偷偷瞄了門一眼。

ex.en: The boy made a furtive attempt to hide the broken cup.
ex.zh: 男孩偷偷摸摸地想把破掉的杯子藏起來。

furlong.zh: 弗隆（長度單位，約 201 公尺）

ex.en: A furlong is an old unit of length used in horse racing.
ex.zh: 弗隆是賽馬中使用的古老長度單位。

ex.en: The horse ran the last furlong very fast.
ex.zh: 那匹馬以非常快的速度跑完最後一弗隆。

ex.en: The futurist predicted how cities might look in fifty years.
ex.zh: 這位未來學家預測五十年後城市可能的樣貌。

ex.en: A famous futurist spoke at the technology conference.
ex.zh: 一位著名的未來學家在科技研討會上發表演說。

ex.en: This is the furthest I have ever walked in one day.
ex.zh: 這是我一天內走過最遠的一次。

ex.en: The furthest star we can see with our eyes is very far away.
ex.zh: 我們用肉眼能看到的最遠的星星，距離非常遙遠。

ex.en: Who can throw the ball furthest?
ex.zh: 誰能把球丟得最遠？

ex.en: Of all of us, Mia traveled furthest to attend the wedding.
ex.zh: 我們所有人當中，米雅為了參加婚禮走了最遠的路。

ex.en: A peach has soft fuzz on its skin.
ex.zh: 桃子的皮上有柔軟的細絨毛。

ex.en: The baby's head was covered with light fuzz.
ex.zh: 寶寶的頭上長著淡淡的胎毛。

ex.en: A government functionary stamped the form and handed it back.
ex.zh: 一位政府官員在表格上蓋章後把它還給我。

ex.en: He was a minor functionary in the city office.
ex.zh: 他是市政府裡一名小官員。
